text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Jingle bells♪ Jingle bells♪
It's Christmaaaas♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us were walking through the streets as Christmas approached.
Perhaps giddy with excitement, Shinko Windy walked with a sway in her step.
choice_data_list: Come on, don't get separated, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Stop nagging me about every little thing!
Anyone who does that gets...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Take thiiis~~! *Chomp*!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rip!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: D-Did Windy-chan plan on ripping it...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr, I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When she crosses the line, she knows how to properly apologize...
Is it too soft of me to feel proud seeing her grow like that?
choice_data_list: It's just a small tear, so you can still wear it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? You're not lying, are you?
It gets cold when the wind blows in through the cracks.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ununu... you... you're pissing me off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Mm! I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm sure that Santa fellow
will take care of it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's why you have to wait until Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Good, good...
Operation Windy-chan Santa...
With this, it's totally flawless nodai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Operation Santa? What's this, what's this,
are you scheming something fun again?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gah! Don't look! It's got nothing to do with—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Biko! You gotta help out too, nanoda!
Lend me an ear, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm... I see!
If that's the case, I'll help out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "On Christmas Day, when I went to the Trainer's Office, the room was fully decorated."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer!
Mwahaha, the trainer's office is now under my control!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's a surprise guerrilla Christmas party!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Here, sit over here!
Ah, wait, let me take your jacket first.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *cough, cough*! It's in the way, so I shall leave it in an empty classroom nearby!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's gonna go get some cake too while she's at it,
so go play with Biko until she gets back!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while enjoying the snacks and juice provided,
I started playing a board game with Biko Pegasus...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: *fidget, fidget... restless, restless...*

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? T-T-T-That's not true!
Preparing a cake takes time, you know!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, look! It's your turn next, Trainer!
Hurry up and roll the dice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm back, yes I am!
I finally finished mend—er, slicing the cake, yes I did!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You did it!
Well then, let's dig right in!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the lively Christmas party came to an end.
As I got ready to leave and put on my jacket...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Trainer?
You look pretty happy about something!
choice_data_list: The torn part has been fixed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stitching was a bit rough... but
it had been neatly resewn.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe...!
How truly fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This must be... Santa's doing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Yeah! I'm sure that's it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them smiled with satisfaction.
Though Santa's true identity was painfully obvious...
I was touched by her thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And on Christmas Day.
While in my dorm room...
It suddenly got awfully noisy outside...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, rattle... Thud, thud...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steeling myself with a pot lid as a makeshift shield,
I whipped the curtain open...
and there, standing before me was—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was Shinko Windy. For some reason, she was jiggling the lock. When I opened the window, she tumbled right inside.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! This room doesn't have a chimney!
And the window is locked tight!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's not a prank!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan is, well, umm...!
S-Su..."

text_block_list.name: Next-Door Neighbor
text_block_list.text:
Um, did something happen?
I heard a strange noise...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be good to cause a weird commotion
this late at night.
In a panic, the two of them slipped out through the window...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Muuugh!!
choice_data_list: I'll take you back to the dorm, so we can talk about the details tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way!! I'm not going hoooome!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There must be a reason for this. It might be better
to change locations and talk it out.
Fortunately, tonight is Christmas...
choice_data_list: Shall we take a short walk outside?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —! ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~! It's so pretty~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's Christmas♪
You sure know some great spots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! You just walked straight out
of your room like that...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... If it's come to this,
I have no choice but to do whatever it takes...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Is this...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... Santa entrusted me with this!
He told me to give it to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Inside... was a large, warm-looking woolen stole."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan will wrap it for you!
Like this, and like this... There!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's fluffy and suits me quite well.
Now I won't be cold!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You can use this as a scarf, a shoulder wrap,
or even a lap blanket!
And if you roll it up, it becomes a pillow too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
With this color... um... it matches that windbreaker
I bit and tore the other day.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a little torn!
Wrapping this will keep me warm...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth... I've been holding back on biting things since then, just a little bit...
Because breaking stuff is bad..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate that.
Still, worrying too much will only build up
unnecessary frustration, which is bad in itself...
choice_data_list: You can chew on the parts that won't tear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...!? Are you serious!?
choice_data_list: As long as it doesn't hurt...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Is it okay? To bite it...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, my teeth were itching a bit...
Like my mouth felt lonely, or something..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Are you really okay with this?
'Cause even if you tell me to stop, I won't!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Then, it's time for a love bite...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: NOMMMMM!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because her strength was lacking, she bit down persistently.
If this is enough to relieve her stress,
it's a small price to pay...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *munch munch... nibble nibble...*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: (What in the world am I doing...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
Christmas night passed us by...!
